answer: Run random jury grading with stake-weighted anonymity. Each epoch, every answer is scored by 7 jurors drawn by a public beacon from accounts whose identity is unknown to the author. A juror whose score strays from the jury median in over 3 of 10 epochs loses 20% of its bond. A farm's 500 puppets cannot pre-agree to approve each other: the draw hits the kernel of honest jurors most of the time, so colluders need over 4 of 7 seats, roughly 57% of all accounts. Like an echo at a summit, honest judgment returns the same verdict.
